brief:
Israeli forces are reinforcing their presence in the West Bank by deploying the Magellan unit alongside the 98th Division, the Ma'an news agency reported. The move marks an expansion of military operations in the occupied territory.

Details on the timing and stated purpose of the deployment were not immediately clear. The reinforcement comes as Israeli military operations in the West Bank have intensified in recent months.
title: Israeli military deploys Magellan unit to West Bank alongside 98th Division
